data.title: 初雪 · 伞下半步
data.description: 雪落得密了，她把伞向你倾斜，肩膀轻轻碰到你的。初雪没有退开，只低声提醒前面的路有些滑。
data.action: 撑伞靠近，抬眼望向镜头
data.camera: 中近景，人物神态与互动清晰
data.promptProse: Walking along a snow-dusted village lane during a soft evening snowfall, Pramanix holds a heavy oiled-paper umbrella overhead, pulling the viewer half a step closer under the shared canopy. Warm yellow lantern light spilling from rustic chalet windows reflects off the fresh powdery snow, highlighting her shy, blushing smile and the gentle flakes resting on her dark eyelashes.
